rec.name: A/B Test-Ready Section Visibility Toggle ("Display Section")
rec.status: Built — checkbox added to 14 Sectionfy sections (Sept 2025); coverage of any other sections unconfirmed

what.text: A "Display Section" toggle in the theme-editor settings of each Sectionfy section. When it is switched off, the section is hidden by default for all visitors. An A/B testing tool can then reveal it for the variant group only, by injecting a short CSS override. The setting is built into every existing section, so a test can be set up without any theme-code changes.

why.text: This element does not persuade shoppers directly. It removes the setup effort for tests of the sections it is attached to, such as social proof banners, upsells, free-gift bars and store benefits. Tests can launch faster and more cleanly, with no flicker or theme duplication. The control group never sees the section, and the variant group sees it only once the CSS is injected. That gives a clean split and more tests per month, which compounds into conversion and AOV gains over time.

how.text: 1) In each section's schema, add a boolean setting "Display Section" (default on). 2) When it is off, the section outputs CSS that hides its wrapper (display:none), using the section's wrapper class such as .shopify-section-story-icon-slider. 3) Leave the toggle off in the theme. 4) In the A/B tool (e.g. Convert, VWO or Shopify-native tools), add the variant CSS from the helper text: .shopify-section-<section-name> { display: block !important; }. 5) Run the test, then switch the toggle on permanently if the variant wins. The lead developer estimated about 5 minutes per section, and the setting must be added to each section individually.

items: Display Section (on/off toggle, default on) — off hides the section for everyone
Helper text in the editor shows the exact CSS override to paste into the A/B tool, using the section's own wrapper class (e.g. .shopify-section-story-icon-slider { display: block !important; })

dependencies.text: Requires a Sectionfy-based Shopify theme and an A/B testing tool that can inject custom CSS for the variant. No metafields or apps are needed for the toggle itself. The CSS class name differs per section. Sections covered per the developer's comment: Announcement bar, Sub-collections, Testimonial Videos, CP product slider, PDP Store benefits, PDP Styling of payment bar, PDP Social proof banner, Cart Reservation Label, Cart Upsell, Cart Free Gift, Cart Store Benefits, Cart Styling of Payment Bar, Cart Promo Banner, Video Play Button Thank you.

items: Setup time per A/B test (minutes from idea to live)
Number of tests launched per month
Conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor of the variant (section shown) vs. control (section hidden)
Flicker or layout-shift incidents on variant load

images.caption: Theme-editor setting "Display Section" (toggle on) with helper text: uncheck to hide the section, and use the shown CSS to reveal it during an A/B test.
